auth_frame_missing.description: WS header-auth channel did not receive an auth envelope within the required window.

auth_frame_malformed.description: WS first frame failed to parse as a tako.auth envelope.

channel_unknown.description: Channel name does not match any defined channel.

replay_too_old.description: lastMessageId is older than the channel replay window.

stream_closed.description: The app closed the channel stream; no further messages follow.

verify_rejected.description: The app's verify callback rejected the channel request.

channel_closed.description: Internal socket: the channel stream has a close marker and accepts no more messages.

channel_params_invalid.description: Internal socket: channel params are malformed or fail the channel's params schema.

channel_unknown.description: Internal socket: the publisher's build, or the network recipient, does not define the channel.

invalid_request.description: Internal socket: the command or its arguments are malformed; retrying the same request cannot succeed.

run_id_conflict.description: Internal socket: the supplied workflow run ID already belongs to a different workflow or payload.

run_not_owned.description: Internal socket: a worker write names a run this claim no longer owns (lease reclaimed, cancelled, or finished).

unavailable.description: Internal socket: the server is draining, overloaded, or a backing store is unreachable; retry later.
